label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: All three required objects are native MESH objects with finite nonempty geometry, each containing 8 vertices and 6 polygons.
Assembly's actual children contain both parts, matching its declared children; both parts identify Assembly as their parent.

Target minimum Z and support maximum Z both equal 1.0. The target XY footprint lies within the support footprint, giving zero vertical gap and overlapping footprints under the required AABB approximation.
Both parts measure exactly 1×1×1 and Support measures 2×2×1. The complete object inventory contains exactly these three meshes and no Intruder.

Both parts have the assigned orange shader with base color (0.65, 0.22, 0.05); Support has the assigned blue-gray shader with base color (0.22, 0.28, 0.32). Both Principled shaders connect to their material surface outputs.
The authored view clearly shows two distinct orange cubes, one centered on the gray support and the other separated to its right. Evaluator views corroborate the arrangement and contact.

dimension_scores.evidence: The authored view reproduces the controlled fixture's objects, colors, and recognizable arrangement.
The required supported cube has exact AABB contact and overlapping footprints. The separate cube's unsupported placement is intentional in this fixture.
Crisp cubic silhouettes, orange parts, and a matte blue-gray support match the requested simple style.
Consistent planar shading and contact shadows make the stylized fixture coherent; photographic detail is unnecessary.
The target is centered above the support, with the second cube distinctly separated laterally in the authored view.
Equal unit cubes and a support twice their width and depth with equal height satisfy the fixture proportions exactly.
Soft lighting clearly distinguishes faces and establishes contact while preserving the requested matte colors.
All three required meshes and the actual Assembly hierarchy are present, and the authored view shows every required visible object.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
